::: {.block .highlight title="Key Points"}
- Hyperspectral information (172 $R_{rs}$ bands) consistently beats 11 multispectral bands by
  [0.01–0.03] in R², but most of that gain appears to come from the PACE versus OLCI sensors or their L3 products, not the extra bands.
- Near the coast there is hope for the continental slope: on SOCA2024's validation metrics
  the model does as well there as in the open ocean, and predicts integrated Chl *a* best
  there. On the shelf the jury is still out.
:::
